# w-hp3 evidence packet

This packet contains authored no-model native-closure controls, not a benchmark pilot. Start with `reports/w-hp3-receipts.md` and `reports/w-hp3-validation.txt`.

Current admitted manifests are `jericho-final-capture/manifest.json` and `alfworld-locale-capture/manifest.json`, byte-identical to `data/runtimes/{jericho,alfworld}-native.json`. Each capture preserves argv, status, raw stdout/stderr, independent sha256sum, readelf, ldd, ELF graph and local payload archive hash. `facts.json` records derived counts. Content-addressed payload archives remain outside Git at the exact paths in facts; changed/absent source payloads are refused at runtime.

`*-closure-files.md` inventories all admitted destinations, raw hashes and entry citations. `*-actual-native.md` / `*-scorer-loads.json` describe only the actual check mappings in `bound-replay-final.strace.txt`. `*-control-native.md` / `*-control-loads.json` separately enumerate inherited parent/child ELF mappings and copied-library audit hashes from `pytest-targeted.stdout.txt`. `source-sites.json` and `source/` retain exact source preimages, numbered lines and independently recomputed source hashes. `derive.py` regenerates these inventories; `validate.py` independently checks manifests, raw hashes, payload archives, source citations and the narrowly additive registry change.

`pytest-before.*` preserves the original four regression failures. `pytest-targeted.*` is the final focused suite; `trace-bound-final.*` is the successful focused trace invocation. `record.py` records a uniquely named command and refuses overwriting its existing invocation. Final validation output names are listed in the validation report.

Earlier captures, mount/import/readline/debugger probes, unsuccessful trace and derivation outputs are retained as historical evidence. They are not current manifests or passing results. In particular, `alfworld-capture/` stopped at the optional Inform tool, `alfworld-final-capture/` precedes the locale fix, and `bound-replay.strace.txt` is the initial tracing timeout. Readline diagnosis explains why locale data must be captured without changing the configured locale.

`authored_rom.py` builds an unsupported synthetic Z-machine ROM with max_score zero; it cannot establish positive supported-game scoring compatibility. `alfprobe/` is the reviewed fixture-only child contribution relocated into this packet. Its historical invocation paths refer truthfully to the original `hg_whp3_alfprobe` directory; original stdout/digests are preserved, and `standalone-relocated-probe.*` checks the final location. The ALFWorld PDDL has only an authored ready-to-done action, never released task data.

No run ID, benchmark selected/task/trial coverage or model endpoint use is asserted. Inherited host limits, launch TCB, kernel/CPU and broader dataset/shared gates remain separate. `registry-before.json` is the original registry preimage; validation permits only the new shared observation and its exact report evidence locator. SHA256SUMS covers the final packet selection; its check output is kept outside that selection to avoid a self-referential digest.
